timeline.tweet: Our multi-talented 2nd #TYPify2018 poet today is the fantastic Emily Horne:"I started writing and illustrating poetry just over a year ago, when I was diagnosed with depression & anxiety. Writing became an essential outlet, and shaped up to become my collection 'Saltwater'."
